# Where to get help

Start with the [installation guide](https://example.com/docs/install "Install")
and the [frequently asked questions](https://example.com/faq). If something is
still unclear, read the [troubleshooting notes][troubleshooting].

![Screenshot of the settings page](images/settings.png)

Release notes are published at https://example.com/releases, and the project
chat lives at <https://chat.example.com>. You can also browse
www.example.com/blog for longer articles (https://example.com/blog/rss for the
feed).

[troubleshooting]: https://example.com/docs/troubleshooting
